# GitHub Badges & Achievements Strategy Guide

Comprehensive strategy guide for maximizing GitHub achievements on your profile:

| Badge | How to Unlock | Tiers Available |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **🚀 YOLO** | Merge a pull request without code review | Single Tier (Unlocked ✅) |
| **⚡ Quickdraw** | Close an issue or PR within 5 minutes of opening | Single Tier |
| **🦈 Pull Shark** | Have merged pull requests | Bronze (2), Silver (16), Gold (128) |
| **👯 Pair Extraordinaire** | Co-author a commit in a merged PR | Bronze (1), Silver (10), Gold (24) |
| **🧠 Galaxy Brain** | Answer marked as accepted in GitHub Discussions | Bronze (2), Silver (8), Gold (16) |
| **⭐ Starstruck** | Repository receives stars | Bronze (16), Silver (128), Gold (512) |
| **💖 Public Sponsor** | Sponsor an open-source contributor | Single Tier |
